# v3.12-dev

Housekeeping. No functional change — comments and documentation only.

## Changed

- **Code comments describing the two shapes a partner-program dashboard can
  take now describe the shapes themselves** rather than naming particular
  programs. A comment that said a layout was "X-style" told you nothing unless
  you already knew X; the same comments now say what the layout actually does —
  counting attained people, counting compliant theatres, or counting global
  holders against a per-theatre minimum. Eight files, comments only, no
  behaviour affected.

- **One historical release-notes file was reworded** for the same reason. The
  published release it was written for is unchanged; only the copy kept in the
  repository has been brought in line.

## Why

The project's data-hygiene rules require that no real customer, partner,
product or program name appears anywhere in the source, its comments or its
release notes — this is a generic product, and examples should read as generic.
The automated check that runs on every change can only spot patterns like email
addresses and file paths, so this category depends on review; this pass closes
what that review found.
